inv.desc_es:
MORALOBO traspasa fantastico local junto a la Plaza Mayor en Sol!
El local dispone de licencia definitiva de Bar Restaurante y tiene salida de humos y tiene autorizada una licencia de terraza exterior en la calle de 2 mesas y 8 personas.

El local es ideal para celebrar musica en directo con espectaculos en vivo ya que tiene un ambiente muy agradable con varios ambientes diferentes y de estilo abovedado con ladrillo visto en sus distintas estancias.

La ultima actividad tenia ambiente andaluz con tablao flamenco y se hacian multitud de eventos y reservas para turistas y empresas.

El local dispone de aire acondicionado por conductos en todo el local y tiene tambien almacen, cuarto de personal, una pequeña cocina con barra y dos baños para clientes.

El local tiene un encanto muy peculiar y único y especial en Madrid ya que es ideal para toto tipo de restaurantes (hindu, japones, italiano, arroceria, marisqueria, asador, etc) y esta decorado de una forma muy atractiva para los clientes

La ubicación del local es excepcional ya que esta a escasos metros de la Plaza Mayor y del Mercado de San Miguel y el flujo peatonal y de turistas es constante durante todo el dia y esta rodeada de todo tipo de comercios y servicios y esta mjuy próximo a la boca de metro de Sol y de varias paradas de autobuses.
inv.desc_en:
MORALOBO is transferring a fantastic premises next to Plaza Mayor in Sol!
The premises has a definitive Bar-Restaurant license, is equipped with a smoke vent, and is authorized for an outdoor terrace license on the street for 2 tables and 8 people.

The space is ideal for hosting live music and performances, as it has a very pleasant atmosphere with several different areas and a vaulted style with exposed brick in its various rooms.

The previous business had an Andalusian theme with a flamenco stage and hosted a multitude of events and reservations for tourists and companies.

The premises has ducted air conditioning throughout and also includes a storage room, staff room, a small kitchen with a bar, and two restrooms for customers.

The space has a very peculiar, unique, and special charm in Madrid, making it ideal for all types of restaurants (Indian, Japanese, Italian, rice specialty, seafood, steakhouse, etc. ), and it is decorated in a way that is very attractive to customers.

The location of the premises is exceptional, as it is just a few meters from Plaza Mayor and the San Miguel Market. The flow of pedestrians and tourists is constant throughout the day, and it is surrounded by all kinds of shops and services, and is very close to the Sol metro station and several bus stops.
inv.title_en: Bar, restaurant for transfer in Sol
